notes: A backtest run's payload, its summary, its trial record and every tool speak run_id; the run store keys on id. 5.14.0 set only the first, so the store minted a second identifier at the write and get_backtest_run on the id a run had just reported refused by name — a refusal that was true about the store and false about the world, which is the worst kind. The two are now one string, for completed runs and for refused ones alike, because a refusal is a result and is stored like one. A regression test asserts the identity across both paths. Found the same way every real defect in this project has
